description: Source code implementing Code 39 barcode generation, including classes for standard and extended Code 39 barcodes, with encoding and validation methods.

classes.name: _Code39Base
classes.description: Base class for Code 39 barcode, providing common properties and decompose method.

classes.name: Standard39
classes.description: Class for generating standard Code 39 barcodes, encoding only standard characters.

classes.name: Extended39
classes.description: Class for generating extended Code 39 barcodes, supporting additional characters via pair encoding.

methods.name: _encode39
methods.description: Encodes a string into Code 39 barcode pattern, optionally appending a checksum character.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Converts encoded barcode pattern into decomposed pattern with interleaved bars and spaces.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value against allowed characters for standard or extended Code 39.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated input into barcode pattern.
